task.title: Sign in
task.shortdesc: Sign in with Google to start runs and decide rules. Reading needs no sign-in.

step.cmd: Select Sign in in the console header and choose your Google account.

stepresult.p: If your address is on the deployment's allowlist, the write actions become available.

postreq.p: If the console says it is read-only, sign-in isn't configured on this deployment. See .
